criteria_hidden_attestation.limit: Hidden criteria, one-generator-per-case, move-once finalization, and no quality resampling are generation attestations; exact prompt projection, unique tasks, frozen hashes, absent staging, and later scoring corroborate but cannot directly reveal unseen generator context.

baseline_reference.finding: baseline/manifest.json documents a repository-validator wrapper applied after scoring and independent audit. Each current file equals its frozen response body followed by exactly one LF plus the documented Case ID/Reviewer ID block. Current wrapped hashes match manifest.response_hashes; stripping only that exact suffix reproduces manifest.response_body_hashes, the generation-attestation hashes, byte counts, and word counts for all five cases.

scoring_method.rule: Award 1 only when every clause is explicit in the response; any missing clause yields 0 and no omitted detail is inferred.
